method: Fresh production readback; provisional verse-context semantic triage, no independent classical tafsir certification

records.reason: Zaqqum tree and its frightening appearance in 37:65; 56:52 names the tree of zaqqum, but not its appearance.
37:66 says they eat from the tree and fill bellies; 56:53 says they fill bellies from it.
37:67 describes a mixture of scalding drink after the tree; 56:54 describes drinking boiling water after eating.
37:68 describes their return to Hell; 56:56 calls the food and drink their hospitality on Judgment Day, same punishment sequence but different detail.
37:69 says they found their fathers astray; 43:22 records reliance on ancestral tradition, without explicitly saying those fathers were astray.
37:70 says they rushed along their fathers' tracks; 43:23 reports following forefathers' path.
37:71 says most predecessors went astray; 36:30 laments servants who mock messengers, a general rather than precise parallel.
37:72 says warners were sent among them; 35:24 states no community lacked a warner.
37:73 calls readers to consider the fate of warned people; 10:73 describes the specific fate of Noah's deniers.
37:74 and 37:40 share the same exception for God's sincere/chosen servants.
